banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Propagate an edge change; nominal configuration must not imply all origins have converged.
sourceRequiredBehavior: Retain old origins until routing changes have converged sufficiently for safe retirement.
sourceAcceptance: Old origins remain until required observed propagation/drain gates pass; desired configuration is not mistaken for complete edge convergence.
sourceQualification: D-S110 requires actual gateway changes and distributed origin/cohort probes. This A card supplies fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY, never those native operations or observations.
preconditions: Open the complete resource-free bundle in a JavaScript-capable browser.
Three fictional POP/cohort samples, two origin labels and two configuration epochs are the entire declared fixture.
Authored response/latency outcomes and old-origin work are DATA ONLY; the fictional journey budget is 120 ms.
actions: Select one fixed trace and rehearse nominal 100% candidate epoch 2.
Optionally check retirement before sampling; unknown evidence must retain the old origin.
Explicitly sample the authored effective destinations, journey outcomes and old work.
Check all required observed gates before fictional retirement.
Inspect retained positive, negative and unknown history; explicitly reset or repeat within six runs.

syntheticInput.observationPolicy: Every edge, POP, route, configuration, latency, response and origin observation is fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY.

expectedAssertions: Nominal 100% candidate configuration leaves propagation, drain and journeys unknown.
A nominal-only retirement check is unverified and retains the old origin.
All required sampled routes, zero observed old work and successful in-budget journeys permit only fixture-scoped fictional retirement.
A stale route or undrained old work blocks retirement even when requests succeed.
Missing POP or old-work observations are unknown, not successes or zero work.
Slow and failed journeys remain interruptions even when sampled routing and drain pass.
Malformed inputs, forged state and out-of-order or over-budget actions fail without mutation.
Keyboard, focused errors, reset, retained history and restrictive CSP work in the actual browser.
limits: No actual resource, edge, network, DNS, route, configuration, origin, identity, credential, deployment or spend operation.
No clock, random sampling, remote data, framework, package installation or server.
Positive coverage is exactly three authored POP/cohort samples, never universal global convergence.
In-memory history survives ordinary actions only; explicit reset or page reload clears it.
No certification of native B-S110, source parent D-S110, actual drain, availability or safe real retirement.
Node 22 is local test tooling, not production Node 24 validation.
Offline Playwright 1.56.1 and installed Microsoft-signed Edge 156 with the published isolated helper only; the inactive lifecycle prototype is unqualified.

verification.normalVerification: Read-only. Exact deliberate CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 is required to write browser proof.
